final: WITH ratios AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type, SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), average_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM ratios) SELECT r.media_type, r.ratio, r.track_count, r.ratio - a.avg_ratio AS difference FROM ratios AS r CROSS JOIN average_ratio AS a WHERE r.ratio > a.avg_ratio
